chunks.text:
[Intro - a cappella gospel choir, then the band hits]
Open... all night!
positive_styles: warm analog 1970s production with modern punch

chunks.text:
[Instrumental groove]
{horn fanfare riff, strings sweep up}

[Verse 1]
Two a.m. and a kid can't sleep,
she's learning all the stars for free.
Grandma's laughing on a call from Rome,
a stranger's video fixed the sink at home.
positive_styles: female soul lead vocal, clear diction

chunks.text:
[Pre-Chorus]
You never see the wires, you never hear the gears,
but in the blink of an eye a whole market appears.
Somebody pays (blink!) and the page is yours,
every little window, every open door!

[Chorus]
Keep it open all night! (all night!)
Every window, every door, every kid gets a light!
All it costs is a glance (a glance!)
and the whole world's yours tonight,
keep it open all night!
positive_styles: full gospel choir call and response

chunks.text:
[Verse 2]
Tiny shop on a side street, one good loaf of bread,
one little ad and the whole town's fed!
Penny papers, radio, the TV in the den,
every time the world got free, somebody paid for it then.
positive_styles: female soul lead vocal, clear diction

chunks.text:
[Bridge - breakdown]
Nobody ever wrote a love song for the ads,
for the little gears behind the glass,
so here's one! (here's one!)
Everybody sing it back!
positive_styles: drum fill and riser into key change

chunks.text:
[Final Chorus - key change up]
Keep it open all night! (all night!)
Every window, every door, every kid gets a light!
All it costs is a glance (a glance!)
and the whole world's yours tonight,
keep it open, keep it open all night!
positive_styles: key change up a whole step
full gospel choir and soaring lead ad-libs
final horn stab then choir hold
warm fade on the last chord
